event.title: Implement #112 completely, replacing #111's stub and wiring config-load chance j
event.head: 3e054b1326

decisions: Added LootChanceCache, which computes all loaded loots' exact content chances per config snapshot on adapter.async(), publishes only when its generation and snapshot are still current, returns empty for stale snapshots, and notifies listeners after publication.
Wired chance computation to plugin enable and every config reload through loadConfig; opening a wiki page never starts chance work.

Loot pages render content in roll order while chances are pending, then refresh in place, sorted by exact chance with always-included entries last; stack amounts are capped at the item maximum while lore keeps the configured amount.
Weight-zero entries are removed before item resolution; missing non-hidden entries become barriers labelled source:id with blank source treated as vanilla.

The loot page info icon uses the layout item, decorated with description, open mode, lock/no-lock, life/unending, rolled item range, and world-timer lines sorted by world name, with no-worlds shown when applicable.
Content and info icons have no actions or sounds; back returns to the saved list page.
Extracted the shared TimeText formatter and kept HologramService.time delegating to it so hologram tests are unchanged.
Added the 18 loot-page language keys with real translations to en.yml, vi.yml, and zh.yml, preserving the existing #109/#110/#111 menu renderer, service, list order, permissions, and paging behavior.

findings.issue: An always-included entry shows 'Chance: calculating' until the chance cache publishes.

label.why: Its reproduction failed when the harness reran it on the branch; sent to the worker.

findings.issue: A missing info-layout item is decorated as loot info, losing the menu barrier name and lore.
